verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly reference OpenAPI import functionality ("Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI"), confirming Hoppscotch supports OpenAPI spec import into collections, but the evidence pack lacks detailed first-party documentation of the full import workflow (e.g., generating individual requests, handling schemas/auth from spec) and no independent/hands-on corroboration exists. missing for 10: dedicated OpenAPI import documentation page, hands-on/community confirmation of the import experience, coverage of edge cases like schema validation or auth import.
